fields.description: Issue features an ongoing investigative series alleging abuse, neglect, and financial irregularities at the Miami Retreat, including claims that private-pay patients were reclassified as county charity cases and that patients were chained or restrained; includes testimony attributed to retired New York detective Edward (Dick) Tracy and references to manager Harry Ayres and nurse Miss Tulley. Other items cover Disabled American Veterans Post No. 10 urging Gov. Warren and state officials to investigate the Retreat; a bulletin about a Jackson Memorial Hospital intake-record discrepancy; commentary opposing proposed increases in Miami water rates and discussing Biscayne Bay pollution; a report on oil activity west of Miami in the Sunniland oil fields; discussion of fraudulent spiritualist practices; and a notice that the Dade County Red Cross campaign was short of its goal.
contributor: Disabled American Veterans Post No. 10 (Miami, Fla.)
